about.title: Built by people who play the game
paragraphs: KB Sports India is a sporting goods store on Sanatan Dharam Road at Inderganj Chauraha, known locally for its range of cricket bats and gear alongside badminton, football, fitness and team wear.

Customers keep coming back for the same reasons: equipment that holds up, prices that stay fair, and a staff that takes the time to help you find the right bat, racquet or shoe — not just sell you one.
Whether you're a school team stocking up before the season or a weekend player replacing a worn-out grip, KB Sports India carries the brands serious players ask for.

hero.lead: From match-ready cricket bats to badminton, football and fitness kit — KB Sports India has outfitted Gwalior's players for years, with honest pricing and staff who know the game.

items.text: First class quality sports equipment and service.
Gentle staff, well mannered, and on point pricing.
Very good products and at good prices, and their behaviour is so good.

categories.title: Cricket
categories.desc: English willow and kashmir willow bats, balls, pads, gloves and full kits from SG, SS, SF, DSC and JKI — the store's founding specialty.

categories.title: Badminton
categories.desc: Racquets, shuttles and stringing from Yonex and Head, set up for club players and weekend regulars alike.

categories.title: Football
categories.desc: Match and training balls, boots and shin guards from Nivia and Cosco, for school teams and turf leagues.

categories.title: Fitness & Gym
categories.desc: Dumbbells, mats, resistance gear and home-gym essentials from Rakshak, GKI and Nexton.

categories.title: Apparel & Footwear
categories.desc: Sports shoes and training wear from Wilson, Stag and JJ Jonex, sized and fitted in-store.

categories.title: Team & Custom Orders
categories.desc: Bulk kit and jersey orders for schools, academies and clubs — ask in-store for team pricing.
